Package com.github.crittscott.somestacks.util

Interface SlotAccess

All Known Implementing Classes:
StackItemStorage
public interface SlotAccess
A numbered range of item slots, matching the Forge and NeoForge IItemHandler contract so their capability views stay thin adapters. This is the internal storage primitive for block entities, piles, and columns; only the Forge/NeoForge capability and Fabric Transfer API adapters that expose it to automation are loader-specific.

    • insertItem

      @Nonnull net.minecraft.world.item.ItemStack insertItem(int slot, @Nonnull net.minecraft.world.item.ItemStack stack, boolean simulate)
      Inserts as much of stack into slot as isItemValid(int, net.minecraft.world.item.ItemStack) and getSlotLimit(int) allow. Returns the remainder that was not accepted — ItemStack.EMPTY if all of it was — and never mutates stack itself. When simulate is true, the slot is left unchanged and only the would-be remainder is computed.

    • extractItem
